rules.why: Claude Code's working line over its input box (since 2.1.2xx it no longer says "esc to interrupt"): a spinner glyph (· ✢ ✳ ✶ ✻ ✽, "*" on some terminals), its verb with "…", then maybe "(23s · ↓ 1.2k tokens · thinking)", cut where a narrow pane wraps it. Its finished form ("✻ Worked for 23s") has no "…". Tested line by line.
Claude Code runs no hook when Esc stops its turn: it says so above its prompt ("⎿  Interrupted · What should Claude do instead?"). Tested on the last line above its input box.
